requirements.summary: Center-align the medications page content horizontally within the viewport
acceptanceCriteria: The medications page content is horizontally centered on the screen
The layout maintains responsiveness across different screen sizes
The centering works consistently with the existing Design B theme styling

file_operations.description: Add horizontal centering to the medications page layout by wrapping the content in a centered container. Use Tailwind classes like 'mx-auto' with max-width constraints to center the content while maintaining the existing Design B theme styling and mobile-first responsive design approach. Ensure the layout works consistently across different viewport sizes without modifying the DesignBAppShell structure.
